subject: SMC GPIO13 shared Wi-Fi/Bluetooth enable command for future J293/T8103 PCIe work
source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative path LF, sorted, over the five listed files; report/log excluded

source_evidence.scope: Pinned MIT experiment names shared Wi-Fi/Bluetooth SMC GPIO13 and uses gP0d enable. It is not a measured current line level or board-specific electrical/power proof.
source_evidence.register_distinction: SMC key gP0d, not a main AP GPIO13 MMIO offset, not PERST main AP GPIO152, and not internal APCIE reset.

implementation.action: One explicit fixed enable command in host fake mode only. No off value, caller-selectable pin/key, retry, reset pulse, sleep or power-cycle path.
implementation.fake_file: 16 four-byte host-memory slots; callback accepts only gP0d/01008000 and changes only slot13, preserving all15 sibling slots.
implementation.default_and_kernel: Return ARS_GATED without invoking any callback. KERNEL+ARS_FAKE_GPIO_FILE is a compile error. APB_FAKE_REGISTER_FILE is also refused, preserving shared PHY/PMGR write gates.
implementation.no_readback_invention: No SMC read transaction or readback encoding is assumed. Fake storage is a command file, not a modeled electrical pin. The source does not establish current line level or need for a new enable write.
implementation.success_label: ARS_FAKE_ACCEPTED/command_accepted mean complete simulated command acceptance only; state_known always0, including success and a repeated enable with identical fake bytes already stored.
implementation.failure_ownership: dirty and writes_attempted set before the callback. A callback error may follow an applied command; it remains ARS_IO, command_accepted0, state_known0, with no rollback/disable or silent retry.
implementation.lifetime: Single-threaded caller serialization; stable non-reentrant callback/context. Arbitrary C callbacks are not sandboxed.
implementation.deployment: New isolated source/tests/docs only. No actual SMC/RTKit/endpoint transport, IOKit adapter, SMC ownership mechanism, board power guard, CMake/Nix recipe or target packet integration.

modes: Host-compiled KERNEL macro gate (not XNU SDK)
cases: Exact ASCII key, exact four-byte little-endian command, one callback per request, unchanged siblings
Explicit repeated enable performs one command and still reports state unknown; no already-on optimization
Null snapshot and missing fake callback remain argument failures with no fake write
Fake error before/after application retains dirty, actual fake slot contents and error without claiming power state
Default/KERNEL with supplied fake callbacks or NULL backend return gated with zero callbacks and all fake bytes unchanged
Compile refusals for KERNEL+radio fake flag, shared-PHY/PMGR fake-write flag, and NDEBUG tests
Preprocessed default/KERNEL radio function has no io callback reference; existing shared-write branches have no writer calls; linked existing slices report shared_writes_compiled0
Source shape contains one fake key write and no hardware transport/MMIO/reader/other-key implementation
mutants: Promote simulated acceptance into known live state
host_validation.mutation_rule: Passing unmodified fake-mode baseline required first. Each mutant compiles then fails an assertion; compile failure does not count.
host_validation.repository_wide_checks: Not rerun for this bounded host-only slice; no repository-wide, SDK, KC or hardware readiness inferred.

provenance.new_code: Original darwin-lab command wrapper and fake GPIO tests; no GPL source read or pasted for this slice.
provenance.upstream_use: Only pinned MIT source facts about shared control identity, key, command and byte order. No upstream implementation imported, executed or relicensed.

not_established: Whether shared radio enable is already on or needs another write
J293 electrical rail topology or Wi-Fi-only rail

next_gate: Independent source review; a future genuine SMC owner, board binding and shared-radio handoff/settle contract are separate work. The host fake flag never authorizes actual kernel pin drive.
